name: Hammond XK-1c
description: Hammond XK-1c portable organ: every global, patch and Leslie parameter its owner's manual gives an NRPN, and the drawbars by their controllers.

sources.title: XK-1c Owner's Manual (V1.00)
sources.notes: The MIDI INFORMATION appendix (PDF pages 124 - 132): its parameter tables, their examples and the Drawbar Data List 2, read by tools/profiles/hammond/read-hammond-tables.mjs from owners-manual-XK-1c-101613.pdf (sha256 d84e4693ca7f897a78777505d703247e136ebb3c1d54fdaaf66e37183f39091b), https://hammondorganco.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/owners-manual-XK-1c-101613.pdf, linked from https://hammondorganco.com/legacy-sk. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/hammond/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/hammond/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter but the drawbars is a row of the MIDI INFORMATION appendix's Global, Patch and Leslie tables, sent as its NRPN on the Upper channel (the channel variable), as the appendix's examples are: CC 99 its MSB, CC 98 its LSB (the table prints the LSB first), then the value on CC 6, and for a two-byte value its second 7-bit byte on CC 38. The global setting TRx. NRPN must be On (it is by default). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The drawbars are the Drawbar Data List 2's controllers on the same channel, each level sent as the first value of its band; the drawbar list 1 (one controller per manual, CC 80 - 82, a value per drawbar and level) is not laid out.

Not by SysEx: the Data Set message (F0 55 dd 10 <model> 13 <address> <data> F7) needs the device ID's byte, and the manual gives the setting (1 - 32) but not the byte it sends; and its examples print other models' IDs.

Every row's NRPN is the last two bytes of its SysEx address, but for these, where of the two the one no other row has is taken: Vibrato On Swell: NRPN printed 09 04, SysEx address 00 09 02: the address taken, the NRPN being another row's.
Laid out as the values the row lists, which go past the range it prints: Source (printed 00 - 01, listed 00 - 02).

The Leslie cabinet's rows print no data; each is laid out 0 - 127: Slow Speed Horn, Slow Speed Bass, Fast Speed Horn, Fast Speed Bass, Rise Time Horn, Rise Time Bass, Fall Time Horn, Fall Time Bass, Brake Time Horn, Brake Time Bass, Level Horn, Level Bass, Mic. Angle, Mic. Distance, Horn Character, Amplifier, Speaker, Coloration.
Not laid out, the Leslie rows' second NRPN (NRPN (21), 13 rows): "NRPN OR/21 is switched automatically by Leslie speaker is disconnected/connected".
Left out, rows with no NRPN: Display Short Cut, Display Time Out, Display Pop Up, Name 15 Characters, Cabinet Name.
Left out, rows whose data is not a range or a pair: Min. Limit HF ((Off, -40dB - -5dB)).
